description: Placing blocks: sneak-bridging backwards off a platform with use held, then walking off its end without sneaking; one click into the player (refused) and towering with jump and use held; stairs at the bottom and top of a face and two at a corner; a bottom slab doubled, a top slab; two fences that join and a stone that joins them; a torch on the floor and one on a wall; a door and its top half; snow on snow; stone over short grass; scaffolding climbing; a ladder; a block from the off hand past a stick; a block in creative (kept).

world.note: Fabric client gametest defaults: flat world, no structures, time and weather frozen, no mob spawning

build: item replace entity @a hotbar.0 with minecraft:stone 64
item replace entity @a hotbar.1 with minecraft:oak_stairs 16
item replace entity @a hotbar.2 with minecraft:oak_slab 16
item replace entity @a hotbar.3 with minecraft:oak_fence 16
item replace entity @a hotbar.4 with minecraft:torch 16
item replace entity @a hotbar.5 with minecraft:oak_door 4
item replace entity @a hotbar.6 with minecraft:scaffolding 16
item replace entity @a hotbar.7 with minecraft:snow 16
item replace entity @a hotbar.8 with minecraft:ladder 8
item replace entity @a weapon.offhand with minecraft:cobblestone 8
harness: Fabric client gametest: one client tick per frame, one server tick per client tick
